## "date_metadata_ingested"

**Data type:**  
String  

**Value:**  
Timestamp of the type: ISO 8601:YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ or null.

**Description of metadata field:**  
This field records the date the ingestion client or server generated the initial metadata of the asset.This can help us trouble shoot any issues which occurred during ingestion, and could be useful for data validation during auditing.

**Populated by whom and when:**  
Ingestion server when metadata is first created.

**Updated where and when:**  
Never

**Generated by:**  
Ingestion server.

**Maps to in ARS:**  
"date_metadata_ingested"

**Maps to in Specify:**  
None

**Notes and issues:**  
None
